title: Samsung 11kg Front Load Washing Machine White WW11CG60ADLE $779.99 @ Costco Wholesale (Membership Required)
body:
Deal: Samsung 11kg Front Load Washing Machine White WW11CG60ADLE $779.99 @ Costco Wholesale (Membership Required)

[Justwon] You know, I think I'm okay not getting push notifications from my washer cause why else would this thing have wifi? 🙃
[Megatron] If it could send those notifications every 5 minutes until clothes taken out, it could be a great feature for some. E.g., annoy the hell out of my partner, until s/he puts the bloody clothes out.
[AdModnar] washing machine that features "cloudy day"
what has my life been missing?
[AdModnar] … marketing speak for, a slightly faster spin cycle so the clothes come out perhaps more wrinkled, but drier.
[PinzVidz] Not a bad price. Currently $835.83 delivered on EPP, after trade-in.
[Fistov Stone] I had the 9kg Samsung WW95T654DLE washing machine which looked very very similar to this. It lasted 5 years before bearing failure. Mine is a family of 5, with on average 2 loads a day. Considering I paid $950 I was p1ssed. Followed up with Consumer Affairs and The Good Guys and got a $450 refund. Not sure I'd recommend. I purchased an auto dosing Haier replacement ($650), we'll see how that goes.
[Makaroni] Bought this 3 months ago, albeit the black version, for $632.78 after trade in and coupon stacks. Only gripe I have so far is spin cycle is quite loud compared to my old Auto Dosing Haier, which coincidentally started leaking after 2 years, and again less than 12 months after being fixed under implied warranty.
JB HiFi tried to palm it off, went to consumer affairs, got a full refund.
This is an OK price.
